tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya'i phur sgrub chen mo'i 'chams la sogs kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba phyag len mdzes rgyan bzhugs so// dpal sa skya'i 'chams la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge phur sgrub chen mo 'di la sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku thog nas bzung / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs bar 'chams sbyong yang lan gnyis re mdzad nas/ bzhi pad mchongs pad rnams re re la bsdus pa dang ji bzhin mdzad pa sogs grangs mang nyung sna tshogs dang / rdo rje gsum dang / 'byung lnga'i 'chams gnyis re spor ba dang / re re mdzad pa sogs sna tshogs dang / rak+ta keng rus rnams ci rigs mdzad cing / gzhal yas khang la sgo bzhi ka mdzad/ dngos gzhi la'ang pad skor rgyas bsdus sna tshogs mdzad pa zhig byung 'dug pa so skye byings kyi blor ma shongs pa lta bu'i 'chams 'chug rkyen lta bur song 'dug pas/ nang gi yal 'chams la zhu dag byas pa nas bzung / ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar gro bzhin tshes gcig rtsa 'chams 'chams sbyong rdo rje phyed rkyang gnyis tshar gnyis re/ rgya gram gcig 'byung lnga so so'i 'chams tshar gnyis re/ rak+ta 'chams tshan drug gdab/ keng rus gar byed nas thal sbyar gyi bar gdab/ gzhal yas khang la sgo bzhi/ ling ro shar sgo'i phyogs la dor/ bzlog pa'i phur bsgril kī la ya 'ur chil gyi 'don/ dngos gzhi la phur kha bsgyur ba'i chem brdungs la 'gyur thub las/ thams cad kyi phur pa phyir bsgril la gsungs pas 'chams gral sgor mo de nyid las kha phyir bltas te phur pa bsgril/ rdo rje phyed rkyang gnyis gsum re/ rgya gram 'byung lnga po'i 'chams gsum re rak+ta dang keng rus gsum gdab/ gzhal yas khang 'dra sbrul nag 'khyog 'gros rjes kyi ja grub nas rol mo bcams la yang pa'i pad bskor gcig ban+dha kha sbubs pa sogs so/ /ling ro tshogs kyi nub sgo phyogs su dor/ 'chams sbyong dang dngos gzhi thams cad du pad 'gros rdzogs nas/

rol 'gros kyi gong du pad skor gcig gzhan bzhi pad mchongs pad tshangs ma 'chams yig nang bzhin dang / 'gyings chen yum chen rdzogs pa'i bar gyi bzhi pad rnams 'chams yig las 'di kar gsungs pas re re/ bstan skyong gi skabs su 'chams dpon gyi gong du 'chams sna ba 'gro ba sogs sngon gyi phyag len la med dam snyam pas g.yon gral gyi 'gor 'gro/ bstan skyong grub nas log 'chams kyi skabs su snang ba 'gyur thub kyi dgongs pa 'chams sna bas sna drangs/ slob dpon gyi gzhug sdod yin yang phyis su nged rang phyogs mtshungs tsam mdzad nas slob dpon gyi sngon la log kyang / zam sne sogs su bsgugs nas/ 'chams pa'i gzhug sdud mdzad pas de bzhin ma 'gyur bar bstan skyong grub nas 'chams pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus te/ slob dpon gyi rjes su 'chams sna ba sogs gang bshom gral bsgrigs te 'chams la rdo rje dang me ris 'gros kyis sgo dang je nyer je nyer song ba dang / de 'gros kyi 'chams pa rnams kyi mjug mthud pa'i tshe g.yas kyi rdo rje bris nas sgo tsam slob dpon log grub pa dang / 'chams sna ba nas 'chams gzhug pa'i bar gyi g.yas g.yon gyis rdo rje tshar re bris la log 'chams gzhug pa'i g.yas g.yon gyis rdo rje tshar gsum bris la log 'chams bshad dang 'chams yig gnyis ka'i dgongs pa sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ rjes kyi bya ba brtag dpyad mtha' gsal/ bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod bya ba ni 'gyur thub las srung 'khor gsungs tshar ba'i rjes su phyag rgya'i gar 'chams kyi sgo nas bskyed pa'i zhes sogs nas zhes brjod la lus bsrung zhing zhes sogs bar/ bdag bskyed phur chung gi mjug chog las zur pa zhig gsungs pa 'di nges par brjod cing sgom dgos kyang snga thog rang nas mdzad srol med rung / deng phyin chad nges par ma chad pa zhig brjod bsgom bya'o/

/rnga 'chams 'chams sbyong la jaṃ spos 'khyil 'chams nas/ dpag bsam 'jo 'chams bar 'jol 'chams sngon ma'i rjes su rtse gsum gcig rjes ma gnyis te khyom gsum/ rdo rje phyed rkyang gnyis so sor nas tshar gnyis re/ rkyang 'gros pa'i brda' sprod dang / rnga yom rdzogs nas 'gros kyi slob dpon 'chams gral gyi 'chams sna ba'i 'gor 'gro/ der brda' sprod dang rnga yom grub nas/ rgya gram gcig rdzogs mtshams brda' sprod dang / rnga yom grub nas do rwa bskor zhing 'gros je myur je myur la btang ste 'chams khang sgor slebs pa dang / slob dpon log 'chams thams cad g.yon la khel ba zhig nges par dgos te/ 'gyur thub las 'gros kyi skabs su rdzogs mtshams g.yon phyogs ngos/ zhes gsungs pa 'di rnga yom rjes kyi 'gros thams cad la rigs 'gre yin pas so/ /de nas 'chams pa rnams dal du ma song ba byas la 'chams sna ba sogs rim bzhin log 'chams gzhug pas byings las 'gro yun ring tsam byas la log rnga 'chams dngos gzhi la gong du gnyis yod pa thams cad gsum du spar/ 'byor 'chams sngon ma la rtse gsum gcig dang rjes mar gnyis ka la gnyis re ste khyon lnga 'chams yig gi dgongs pa'o/ /rgya gram gnyis rnams so/ /grub 'chams kyi 'chams sbyong la myug 'chams tsho gsum dang / 'chams dngos la thon 'chams kyi rkyang 'gros rdzogs nas dgug gzhug gcig brjid nas 'chams rgyug 'chams kyi bar gnyis re/ brjid 'chams gnyis pa'i rjes su gnyis 'gros/ ja grub nas rol mo bcams la gong dgug gzhug gi rjes bzhin/ bcoms dang pad skor jaṃ lnga'i rjes rngam 'chams sogs so/ /rgyug 'chams gnyis pa'i rjes su rkyang 'gros/ dgug gzhug gi dod chems brdung / gdab tshul gnyis/ gdab kha drug dang / phyi nang gsang ba ma yas bsdu mas bsdu phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas bzhi 'gros kyi gshegs mas log grub 'chams dngos gzhi la/

'bag rnga sgrog rim 'bag shing gi rtsa ba sngon po de steng dmar po/ de steng pags khang gi hrig la sngon po yar 'then/ de steng ljang gu'i pags khang gi hrig la dmar po yar 'then/ de steng nag pos pags khang hrig la ljang gu 'then/ de steng dar sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa ste 'gyur thub dang sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan gyi zhal bkod 'khrul med yin/ rnga 'chams grub nas gser skyems sogs mdzad pa 'di 'chams yig dang sngon gyi phyag len la/ slob dpon dang 'chams sna ba gnyis ka byon nas slob dpon gdan khar bzhugs/ gser skyems 'thor ba sogs 'chams phal cher 'chams sna bas byed pa yod kyang / yab rje rdo rje 'chang gi sku thog nas bzung / tshangs ma slob dpon gyi byed pa 'di/ don gyi 'gal ba cha cung zad tsam yang ma song bas da lta bzhin byed/ bcom rol sngon 'gro'i nyung 'chams dur khrod bdag po rnams dang / bsgyur thub rnams dngos gzhir 'thon 'chams skabs/ lag khyer ba dang rnga rol rnams 'chams pa'i mdun la rim bzhin phyin te/ so so gral du slebs pa dang / dung rgya gling ma gtogs pa'i lag 'khyer ba langs 'dug gang bde dang / rnga pa rnams gral la sdad/ rol sil gnyis langs/ dgug gzhug grub nas rol sil gnyis yang sdod pa dang / phyi nang gsang ba mar rol sil langs pa'i gsal kha gang yang ma gsungs yang / da lta'i phyag len la don gyi 'gal char 'gro ba gtan nas mi 'dug pas sngar bzhin 'thon 'chams rkyang 'gros rdzogs nas/ dgug gzhug gsum dang lha dbye/ brjid 'chams gsum gyi sngon mar rkyang 'gros dang / rjes ma gnyis dang nyis 'gros/ ja grub nas 'chams tshul gong 'dra/ rngam 'chams/ 'dur 'chams/ rgyug 'chams rnams gsum re/ rgyug 'chams gnyis song mtshams/ ja grub nas 'chams tshul gong 'dra la/ pad bskor bzhi nas btsan 'jus byed/ rgyug 'chams rjes ma la rkyang 'gros dgug gzhug lha dbye bcas gcig gdab tshul gdab kha phyi nang gsang ba rnams yongs rdzogs/

gdab tshul gdab kha'i bzhi 'gros/ gri bskor mar 'chams dal brel gyi rnam gzhag 'gyur thub du ma gsungs kyang / phyag len la rgyug 'chams dang dgug gzhug rdzogs pa'i g.yas 'gying / g.yon 'gying sogs kyi mthar bzhi 'gros brel bar/ gdab tshul gnyis la dal ba/ gdab kha dang po brel ba/ gnyis pa dal ba/ gsum pa brel ba/ bzhi pa dal ba/ lnga pa brel ba rnams mdzad khul ltar dang / 'gyur thub tu gdab kha dang pos chems brdung la/ 'chams dpon gyi phur pa len par gsungs kyang / da ltar dbyangs kyi tshe len pa zhig 'dug rung gang byas kyang mi 'gal bas stabs gang bder/ phyi nang gsang ba ma'i rjes kyi bzhi brdungs ji myur ji myur la gtong ba gsungs shing log 'chams ni gong bzhin no/ /'chams kyi gral la 'chams bshad dang / 'chams yig las gral gyi phreng ba bal thag ltar snyoms shing gsungs pa/ dper na skud pa ring po la phreng ba brgyus pa re re'i bar du gnyis re shong tshod bzhag pa'am/ yang na re re'i shong tshod bzhag pa lta bu dper mdzad pa'i/ do rwa yangs shing 'chams pa nyung ba re re'i bar du gnyis re gshong tshod dang / do rwa dog cing 'chams pa mang na re re gshong tshod kyi gral 'go pa rnams gros bstun gyi bsgrigs la/ de las yang dog tu mi 'gro ba'i do dam 'go pa so sos byed cing / byang sems rnams kyi'ang sgrim/ rnga 'chams la ni gnyis re gshong pa'i bar nges par dgos te/ 'gyur thub las gral gyi phreng ba bal thag ltar snyoms shing cung yangs par byas la/ zhes gsungs so/ /ces dpal sa skya'i phur sgrub chen mo la nye bar mkho ba 'di sa skya pa kun blos bris pa yi ge pa ni bsod 'od do/ ༈ /lcags 'then mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ snang ba 'gyur thub kyi jab nyug dang po'i skabs su 'di ltar gsungs te/ lag gnyis 'then cing sdud pa lcags 'then byed/ de'ang lag g.yas zung du sa la bskyangs/ g.yon pa brang la gzhar nas lag 'go dpung g.yon steng slebs pa dang /

gru mo g.yon phab cing / dpung g.yon rgyab phyogs su bcug rkang g.yon sa la drud/ rkang g.yas kyi bol mtshams slebs pa dang / bgyid ldems ngos nas sig che zhing / mgo bo bskor nas rnga ma dpung pa phyir rgyab la gang bcu ba'i rgyab phyogs su dkrug rnga rol yod na rtser pad kor ltar 'khyil ba gcig dgos/ g.yon la bsnun dus lag gnyis 'dud tshe gzhan 'dra ba las/ rkang g.yas sa la drud/ rkang g.yon bol mtshams slebs pa sogs 'dra/ 'di lag gnyis snying gar mnyam 'dud byung na gru thag 'then zhes 'chams kyi skyon rang du mdzad pas thugs rigs sgrim dgos so/ /'og tu lcags 'then ces pa gang byung dus 'chams tshul 'di dran pa gal che zhes dang / yang de nyid kyi brdab tshul dgos/ dgug gzhug grub pa'i 'chams tshul de'i skabs su 'di rang gsungs te/ dpral ba'i thad tsam du g.yas kyi lag mgos g.yon la nang nas bskor zhing lag gnyis brkyangs te phyag mtshan g.yob pa rnga ma mdun la bseg g.yas skor du dgu brdung drag myur gyi mdun la rol mo lus rnga ma sogs g.yas su mnan cing lag gnyis yom bya/ brgyad la rkang g.yon bteg tsam ngos de phral g.yon phyogs 'phyong zhing dgu la phab/ rkang g.yas sa la drud g.yon gyi 'khris su slebs pa dang / lan gyi rol mo chung ba gcig ste/ bcu pa la lag gnyis 'then byed/ 'then rkang gcig la g.yas phyogs nas lcags 'then rdzogs mtshams bzhi brdung gi gcig dang bzhi la che ba/ gnyis dang gsum la chung ba ste rol mo'i rnam dbye shes dgos so/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid kyi gdab tshul stabs las bzhi brdung gcig la pad skor/ 'then rkang gsum la g.yas g.yon g.yas rnams su lcags 'then byas nas gong bzhin bzhi 'gros/ gri bskor la ji ltar rig pa byed/ ces dang / yang de nyid kyi gdab las dngos gzhi'i skabs 'di ltar gsungs te/ g.yas phyogs su 'phar te bzhi brdung gcig la pad bskor byas nas/

'then rkang bzhi'i bar g.yon zur mdun du bstan pa ngos su jaṃ lcags 'then byed/ de'i rgyab g.yas zur gong bzhin g.yon dang g.yas zur du lcags 'then re/ zhes gsungs pas brdab tshul gong dang / gdab las dngos kyi lcags 'then ma g.yas sngon dang / gzhan jaṃ myug grub 'chams pu ṭa 'chams kyi lcags 'then thams cad lag g.yon sngon ma yin no/ /zhes pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos bris/ ༈ /rdo rje phur pa'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa bklags pas don 'grub las/ gsum pa mjug gi cho ga la tshogs lhag ma las mjug gsum gyi/ dang po la gsum las/ tshogs mchod bshags pa/ bsgral mchod gsum gsungs pa'i bsgral mchod la rgyas pa byed na sngar bzhin bya/ bsdu na dam tshig chen po zhes sogs gsungs pa las/ phur pa'i rnam bshad na bsgral mchod bsdus pa dam tshig chen po sogs kyi bskul dang / ki la ya nyid gcig brjod nas phur pa gcig gis sgrol bar gsungs pa de phyag len phal cher la mi mdzad/ bklags pas don 'grub tu rgyas par byas na sngar bzhin bya gsungs pa de sgrub thabs su gdab kha drug gsungs pa bzhin 'dir byed dgos pa ni sgrub thabs rgyas pa la tshogs lhag ma rnams kyang rgyas pa dang / 'bring bsdus la bsdus pa dgos pa ni bla ma gong ma rnams kyi yig cha so sor mdzad pas shes/ rgyas pa'i bsgral kha'i phyag len ni dgu gtor chen mo'i nyer brgyad la mdzad pa 'dir sor bzhag la bsgral kha grub nas lhag ma rgyas pa gtong na phyi nang gsang ba'i tshe chems brdung rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can dgos pa'i phur bzlog gi rigs 'gre sbyar bas shes/ lhag ma'i rjes su gsum brdeg len can dgos pa ni phur sgrub kyi rigs 'gre sbyar bas shes/ bsgral kha'i rjes su thun gtor 'bul ba dang sbrel na dgu gtor chen mo bzhin yin/ sa bcad gnyis pa lhag ma'i nang sel gyi sa bcad rnams 'dri ma dgos/ gsum pa las mjug la bstan skyong /

zor/ bro brdung / dngos grub blang ba/ bzod gsol/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/ bdag srung / las rjes bsdu ba/ bsngo ba smon lam/ shes brjod de bcu gnyis las bstan skyong ni bla ma gong ma'i phyag len la sgrub pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang mdzad yang bstan skyong nang du mdzad nas bsdus pa dang / phyir mdzad na rgyas pa kho na mdzad/ da lta rang re'i phyag len la dkyil 'khor bsdu ba 'di drag po sgrol dbang kho na'i khyad chos yin pa lta bu zhig mdzad khul 'dug kyang kho bos rtog pa la sngar bsdu dgos min gyi the tshom med pa bzhin nye dus sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring gnyis dkyil chog phur bzlog stod smad kyi rnam bshad rnams la zhib par bltas pas phur sgrub kyi sta gon la/ bdag mdun so sor yod pas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu dgos par gsungs/ dngos gzhi la bdag mdun tha mi dad du sgrub nas rang gtso bo las dbye ba'i gtso bo gnyis pas rig 'dzin bskul dang / phyi rol gtor ma/ bskor ba bzod gsol byas/ dkyil 'khor gsol btab kyi tshe dkyil 'khor gtso bos thugs ka nas dbye ba'i gtso bo gnyis pa rang min pa zhig dbye ba des rang gi bdag 'jug len pa'am/ slob ma la dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab nas gtso bo'i thugs kar thim/ rang gtso bo las dbye ba des bum bskyed bdag 'jug sogs byas nas ras bris ltar na brtan bzhugs dang / rdul tshon ltar na nyin dang po rnams la rten dang rjes ma gshegs gsol las bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor logs su bsdu mi dgos par gsung / drag po sgrol dbang ni bdag mdun so sor yin par mdun bskyed gshegs/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu bar gsungs/ phur bzlog la ni nyin dang po ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom pa nas nub tha mar zor gtor gyi dam ye ma bral bar la/ bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi dkyil 'khor dang /

dam ye bral nas zor gtor gyi ye shes pa rten dang brten par bcas pa nam mkhar bzhugs/ dam tshig pa rten dang brten par bcas zor rdzas su bsgyur ba dang rjes 'brel bzlog dkyil 'khor la gshegs gsol logs su mi dgos par bsdus nas rdul tshon ltar na gtor ma blug thig rjes bsub/ ras bris ltar na dben par bzhag gtor ma rnams sgo la zhal phyogs par sgrigs/ bdag bskyed dam ye rten dang brten par bcas pa logs su phye nas 'khor lo rtsibs bcu bzlog gzhung sogs byas la/ zor 'phangs grub pa dang mjug chog gi dkyil 'khor bsdu mtshams su slebs pa'i tshe bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu bar gsungs pa 'di ni gnam lcags rdo rje'i me dbal na mi gsal yang de'i rnam bshad na shin tu gsal/ dgu gtor chen mo sogs bdag bskyed phur chen gyis byas pa 'di rnams la ni dkyil 'khor nges par bsdu dgos te/ bdag bskyed kho na las bdag mdun tha dad med cing / sgeg cing mi tshe mchod yon du spyan drangs pa'i dkyil 'khor de ni sku thang sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang / rten med na gshegs gsol gyi gras la 'gro bas na rnam dbye 'di dag shes par byas nas/ sa skya pa kun blo rang lo so brgyad lon pa me khyi lo 'di nas bzung / phur sgrub kyi sta gon dang / phur bzlog gi nyin rjes mar drag po sgrol dbang dgu gtor chen mo'i phur 'bring dang phur chen gnas skabs gzhan du sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bdag bskyed byas pa rnams la dkyil 'khor bsdu ba 'di bla ma gong ma'i yig cha dang mthun par btsugs pa yin pas/ de'i ngag 'don ni rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gshegs grub nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha rnams la thim/

'khor gyi lha rnams gtso bo yab yum la thim/ yum yab la thim/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku ma ra sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra kā wā tsi sogs dang / rang bzhin sems sogs/ phur bzlog la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dur khrod brgyad 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la thim/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu sgo ma bzhi/ khro bcu yab yum phra phyag dang bcas pa gtso bo yab yum la thim pa sogs gong bzhin no/ /sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring rnam bshad dang bcas pa na yum bsdu bar bshad/ sngags 'chang chen po'i drag po sgrol dbang na yum mi bsdu bar gsungs so/ /zhes pa'ang phyag len dag pa sgrub pa'i yi ge'o/ /yang rdo rje phur pa'i gtor bzlog gnam lcags rdo rje'i me dbal zhes pa sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa de nyid las bdud rgyal gyi bskul che chung gsung tshar ba'i rjes su bzlog pa'i dzam 'gros kyi gtor ma brdeg par phyin la zhes dang / de nyid kyi rnam bshad 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i 'phrin las 'od zer las/ bzlog pa'i dzam 'gros byed par spro na rol mo bzhi brdung gsum gyi bar la rnga pa rnams g.yas g.yon logs dang / dgu brdung gcig la mchong zhing / yang sngar bzhin g.yas logs g.yon logs dgu brdung sogs skabs su gang babs byas pa'i mthar rol mo bzhi 'gros che chung dal brel snyoms shing mtshams chod pa'i ngang nas zhes gsungs pa las/ 'gros 'di rdo rje dang rtse gsum dang me ris kyi 'gros gang yin gyi gsal kha gtan nas ma byung bas/ da lta'i phyag len la'ang g.yas logs g.yon logs las 'di yin gyi ngos 'dzin mi 'dug kyang / kho bos legs par brtags tshe rtse gsum gyi 'gros nges pa rnyed pas na de'i tshul ni thog mar bdud rgyal gyi bskul chen rdzogs pa'i tshig rol dgu brdung las dgu zhes nem dang we zhes che ba la rnga rol zhal sprod de ka'i ngang nas mdun du sgur ba dang rgyab rgyer ba byas/ bzhi brdung gi gcig la rkang g.yas bteg

gnyis la rnga pa rnams kyi rgyab dang / rol mo ba rnams kyi mdun phab pa yu smad dang / gsum dang bzhi la rkang g.yon goms rdzus kyis phyir spo ba yu stod dang / yang bzhi brdung gcig gi gcig la rkang g.yas bteg bskor zhing zor las pa rnga rol tshang ma gtor ma 'gro bar phyogs pa'i rang gi mdun g.yon du gnyis la phab pa ni g.yon rtse gsum la rkang g.yon g.yas rgyab tu rtse gsum btsugs bzhi la rkang g.yon de nyid du phab/ yang bzhi brdung gcig gi gcig la rkang g.yas bteg kha phyir bltas de nyid kyi mdun g.yas zur du gnyis la phabs pa g.yas rtse gsum dang bzhi la rkang g.yon gong bzhin/ de nas gcig dang gnyis la rkang g.yas bteg nas rtse gnyis kyi dbus su phab/ de bzhin du gsum dang bzhi la rkang g.yon bteg nas rtse gnyis kyi bar du 'bebs pa sogs dgu'i bar la gnyis 'gros kyis 'gro ba ni dbu rtse ste rtse gsum gyi rtse gtor ram 'gro phyogs su ston cing yu ba rang ngos byung bas na bzlog pa dang srung ba'i rkang stabs shin tu 'grig yang 'dab nas bya na yu ba 'bri ba bzung gong bzhin yin la/ 'o na 'di rtse gsum gyi 'gros yin pa rgyu mtshan gang gis shes na/ rdo rje phur pa'i 'chams dpe sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i snang ba 'gyur thub la grub 'chams kyi sngon 'gro rnga 'chams kyi pad gzugs dpag bsam 'jol 'chams kyi rtse gsum 'bri skabs las gcig la rkang g.yas bteg gnyis la rkang g.yas kyi rgyab zur du phabs yu ba yin pa gsungs pa ni/ 'dir yu ba 'bri skabs yang rnga pa rnams kyi g.yas kyi rgyab zur du rkang g.yas slebs pas 'khrul med shes/ rkang g.yas bteg mdun nas g.yon gyi rgyab zur du bzhag pa g.yon rwa yin gsungs pa ni g.yon rwa 'bri ba'i bskor tshul 'dra zhing / 'dir bzlog bsrung gi rkang stabs mi 'chol ba'i phyir g.yon gyi mdun zur du 'byung / rkang g.yas bteg g.yon gyi mdun zur du bzhag pa g.yas rwa yin gsungs pa ni/
